summary: Both teams played last night, Utah is missing Jackson Jr. and Nurkic, and SA is laying 13.5; Utah +13.5 is the most likely leg. Total projects 230.1 vs 233.5.

Dog ML +470 needs 17.5 percent; Jackson Jr. and Nurkic out, so it is only a long shot.
